name: KChip
summary: Status chips: the five words (Needs you, Running, Queued, Finished, Failed), one tone each; a specific ask keeps its group's tone.

tone.description: needs = waits on this person (solid ink); ask = a specific ask inside a Needs-you group; live = happening now; done = finished or passed; failed = broke; "" = neutral.

notes: The words carry the state; the dot never stands alone.

do: Use KStatus for the five words and KHeadlineChip for a task headline (task-status.ts).
Resource states (Idle, Building, Offline) are neutral, live and failed: never the needs tone.
dont: Never use the needs tone for warnings, quota or emphasis.
Never stack several chips on one row.
